selection.decode: Reduce repeated product widening in the default original-PQ2 CPU projection path without changing arithmetic or ISA. Existing independent accumulators already implemented, so no duplicate change.
selection.prefill: Remove scalar-only tiled integer reductions by sharing baseline NEON decoded weights across prompt tokens. Rows remain sequential; loss of ordinary row-worker parallelism still requires full-prompt comparison.
selection.deferred: Existing prefix reuse source awaits application acceptance; fused recurrent copy/decay retains its separate actual-model gate. No speculative, precision or accelerator defaults introduced.

implemented.decode: Two independent i16 product-pair accumulators, widened before final i32 reduction. Products [-256,254], pairs [-512,508], each accumulator lane [-2048,2032], combined lanes [-4096,4064], complete dot [-32768,32512]. PQ2 fourth symbols, signed lanes, quantizers and per-128 float order preserved; PTQ1 helpers unchanged.
implemented.prefill: One decoded block shared across tokens, baseline NEON for PQ2/Q8_K, odd PQ2/Q8_0 and PTQ1/Q8_0 native lanes. Graph backend policy forwarded; scalar forcing, unsupported-target fallback, pinned/unpinned float order, cancellation and output clearing preserved.
implemented.resources: Decoded SIMD block uses bounded stack storage. Test source checks no unused PQ2 consumption-layout allocation; no new retained heap payload or resource admission reduction.
implemented.owningControls: Two new portable prefill controls, expanded backend/pinned parity, five exact Windows ARM64 NEON controls and target inventory regression.
